resolved_by: U.S.S.G. amendment 822 (2023), which moved the inchoate-offense language from the commentary into the text of § 4B1.2(d) and, per the opinion, addressed the circuit conflict
issue: Whether courts may treat the Guidelines application notes defining 'crime of violence' to include inchoate offenses like conspiracy after Kisor v. Wilkie
quote: The Commission explained that the move responded to a circuit split about the authoritative weight of § 4B1.2’s application notes.
cite: United States v. Christopher Lloyd, No. 25-1967 (7th Cir. 2026)
